what_to_do.en: Tap the opposite of the word in quotes.

stages.choice_rule: Offer four single words from the wordlist or allowed_extra_words. Exactly one is the antonym of the quoted word in the sense that stem uses. Never use a phrase. Never repeat the quoted word. Mix answer_index across the pool.

gold_items.stem: The "light" bag was easy to carry.

roots: Keep all four choices as single words from the wordlist or allowed_extra_words.
Exactly one choice is the antonym of the quoted word as that sentence uses it.
Never set a synonym of the quoted word as the key.
Tier 1 distractors stay far: another sense, a color, or a loosely related kid word.
Tier 2 includes one synonym of the quoted word and one related word from the same scene.
Tier 3 must include the antonym of a different sense of the same word, such as light as weight versus light as brightness.
Stems stay in kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands.
Each stem quotes exactly one target word and also uses that same word in the sentence.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words with one quoted target. Picture lemma on the noun. Distractors are far: color, object, or a loosely related word, not a near synonym.
tier_rules.2: Grade-level stems of five to seven words. Two-syllable words are fine. Include one synonym distractor and one same-scene related word.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss stems. The quoted word has two common senses. One distractor is the antonym of the unused sense, such as dark for light-as-weight.

temp_hot.en: Hot means very warm. The opposite of hot is cold.
temp_hot.ko: hot은 아주 따뜻하다는 뜻입니다. 반대말은 cold입니다.

temp_cold.en: Cold means not hot. The opposite of cold is hot.

size_small.en: Small means little. The opposite of small is big.

wet_dry.en: Wet means full of water. The opposite of wet is dry.

right_wrong.en: Here right means correct. The opposite is wrong.
right_wrong.ko: 여기서 right는 맞다는 뜻입니다. 반대말은 wrong입니다.

left_right.en: Here right means the side. The opposite of right is left.
